title: Cinderhead Mine - Veinlight
_note: Option A anchor. gbc 4-voice band. A natural minor, 80bpm (deliberate slow cave cue; benign 'outside tempo range' warning is intentional per brief). Low pulse25 drone-lead moving only a step or two; sparse pulse12 crystal-chime glint every 2-4 bars far up the register; deep slow tri_bass drone held long; distant dry pick-tap drums with vast silence. Vesper fragmented: only the rising leap E3->A3->B3 sounds low in the drone-lead, the settle never fully arrives (loop stays unresolved/uneasy). The crystal chime alone, far above, briefly voices the settle phrase C5->B4->A4 as a glint of hope. 28-bar long loop; last bar voice-leads (G->A pull) back to bar 1.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Low drone-lead. Long held low notes moving only a step or two. The Vesper rising leap E3->A3->B3 is the only fragment that sounds; the settle home never fully arrives. Faintly tense-but-warm, never hurried.
